Name: Harp of Yoba - Genshin Impact Lyre Songs
Author: JoshIsSoapy
Description:
[b]What does it do?[/b]

I have replaced all songs in the Harp of Yoba mod with short 14 second covers of Genshin Impact music, with an exception for serenade of thunder, as this is Abigail's duet song played on Genshin's lyre instead. Here are some of them;

Prelude of Yoba = Dawn Winery / Before Dawn:
[url=http://sndup.net/bq6z]http://sndup.net/bq6z[/url]

Birthday Sonata = Genshin Main Theme:
[url=https://sndup.net/fxjz/d]https://sndup.net/fxjz/d[/url]

Animal Aria = Guizhong Lullaby:
[url=http://sndup.net/r3k5]http://sndup.net/r3k5[/url]

Farmer's Lullaby = Ruu's Song:
[url=http://sndup.net/dwms]http://sndup.net/dwms

[/url]Preview:
[youtube]TOXKBQyyDTw[/youtube]

I played these on a mechanical keyboard, in the game Genshin Impact, using the Lyre instrument you get from the Windblume festival, so some tracks aren't quite perfect, but I hope you like them! 

[b]Why does it do it?

[/b]I love Genshin Impact, and found this cool Genshin Impact hair mod by Demiistar and so I wanted to play songs from Genshin while my farmer is dressed like Venti:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12225]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12225[/url]

[b]How does it do it?
[/b]This mod uses custom music, I learned how to replace the songs by studying the Sounds of Yoba mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3098[/url]
